title: Private Credit Woes Not a Systemic Threat: Powell - BlackRock (NYSE:BLK) - Benzinga
summary: Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell downplays the risk of turmoil in the private credit sector, suggesting it's a correction rather than a systemic event. Oaktree satisfies redemption requests, and Jim Cramer advises selling off private credit exposure but acknowledges the solvency of underlying businesses.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is negative due to concerns about the private credit market's pressure and the advice to sell off exposure, despite acknowledging the solvency of the underlying businesses.
